_comment: Tier-2 for febio::damage#3. <beta> on the `CDF Weibull` property is rejected at parse with 'tag "beta" (line N) : unrecognized tag'. With a small <mu> on a two-equal-cycle history the second cycle's peak equals the first to within a fraction of a percent while sitting far below the undamaged (Dmax = 0) reference — the knockdown was fully applied during cycle 1 — whereas the shipped <mu> still softens between cycles. The comparison against the undamaged reference is required, because equal peaks alone are equally consistent with a model that never damaged anything. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
